physicalNotes: Radius 1.083 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract): 753,443 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.993 +/- 0.067 solar masses from Močnik et al. 2020, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-28 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2020PASP..132a4401M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6150 +/- 140 K from Bonomo et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of WASP-28 b's parameter set from Bonomo et al. 2017 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
